SAME CORRUPTION AS 07-29 — INDEPENDENTLY RE-CONFIRMED, STILL HELD BACK, STILL NOT PUBLISHED. The M+ half refreshed normally: 40 rows parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity (fraction × 100), 35 values moved, range 0.62–38.4, asOf 07-30 — that half IS published. The RAID half is the problem: all 40 committed raid "Popularity" rows still carry DPS/HPS magnitudes under unit "%" (Blood DK 95300, Frost DK 173900, Unholy DK 170000), byte-identical to that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" value — a prior run merged the `dps` column into the Popularity series. This run's live parse of the same field returns correct percentages (Blood DK 28.71, Unholy DK 10.09, Outlaw 0.52), so the upstream field is fine and the fix is a one-line re-merge. Publishing it would move all 40 rows ~100% and shift the family median, which the value-move guard rejects by design (correctly — that is exactly the units shape it exists to catch), and the agent has no channel to approve it. So the corrected raid rows were parsed, verified, and deliberately NOT merged: apply-metrics ran with all 160 Archon rows and the 40 raid Popularity values were then restored byte-for-byte from HEAD, leaving the stored corrupt values and their 2026-07-28 coverage date untouched. This row is partial, not success. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: re-run this workflow with value_move_ack set (e.g. "Archon raid Popularity column-parse corrected, 40 rows rescaled from DPS magnitudes to percent") and the next run lands the fix. Reproduce from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity on the three raid aggregate pages. This is the SECOND consecutive night the fix has been blocked.
